name: ursa-steps
description: Ursa AI "Ask. Build. Analyze. Act." section: a centred heading over stacked glass cards; each card has a numbered label and title beside its copy, then a two-column checklist; a card can be dark (indigo) with the Ursa orb. Ursa AI frame 7261:111601.

title.description: Heading (an H2). Line breaks are kept.

lede.description: Paragraph under the heading. UrsaAI renders as the brand mark.

items.description: Cards. Each: num (e.g. 01), label (e.g. Ask), title, body (UrsaAI renders as the brand mark), checks (list of strings, split into two columns, first column gets the extra one), tone (light | dark; dark = indigo card with the Ursa orb).
